stem: In summer 2025 Voltmarkt's laptop category had €1,600,000 of net sales across all lines. Its markdown lines had a list value of €300,000 and sold for €220,000 net. A two-week back-to-school promotion gave another €40,000 off list on other lines. Voltmarkt's markdown % divides markdown euros by the category's total net sales for the period. What was the laptop markdown % for the summer? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
